title: SIMoE sparse interpolation coefficient factorization

prior_art.fact: SIMoE uses sparse interpolation over reusable expert parameter components to create experts.
prior_art.mirror_delta: Test whether a factorized low-description code can produce sparse interpolation coefficient vectors for unseen factor combinations at lower paid bytes than separately stored rows.
prior_art.mandatory_control: Native SIMoE with independent free sparse coefficient logits for each trained logical expert.

draw.eligible_rule: uniform from P0 + UNTESTED; exclude IDs with live remote origin/research/ma-* branches or existing ma-* experiment directories

task.description: Synthetic regression over mixtures of fixed physical anchor experts. For input x in R^16, each anchor j outputs W_j x + b_j in R^8. Each logical task (domain_id, skill_id) outputs the convex sparse top-3 mixture of anchors.
task.anchor_weights: For each world seed, W is sampled Normal(0,1/16) with shape [12,8,16] and b Normal(0,0.05) with shape [12,8]; fixed and shared for all methods.
task.aligned_world: For every task, coefficient logits are b0 + A z_domain + B z_skill, with rank 2 latent factors. A/B/b0 and factor codes are generated from world seed; target coefficients are softmax of top-3 logits at temperature 0.5.
task.off_orbit_world: Each of the 16 task coefficient-logit rows is sampled independently Normal(0,1) before the same top-3/temperature transform.
task.pair_split: Train/dev tasks satisfy (domain_id + skill_id) mod 2 = 0. Held-out tasks satisfy odd parity. All four domain and all four skill IDs occur in both partitions.
task.data: x is iid Normal(0,I_16), independent per task and split. Train 2048 examples per seen task, development 512 per seen task, held-out support 64 and held-out query 2048 per task.

methods.native_simoe: 12 learned coefficient logits per seen task, trained independently; use top-3 softmax coefficients. For each unseen task, initialize a free 12-logit row at zero and adapt only that row on its 64 support examples for 300 full-batch Adam steps.
methods.mirror_factorized: Shared bias plus shared 12×2 domain/skill generators and per-domain/per-skill 2D polar coordinates (radius, angle); convert each coordinate to radius*[cos(angle),sin(angle)], sum projected factors into 12 logits, then top-3 softmax. Unseen tasks are composed zero-shot from previously trained factor codes.
methods.ordinary_low_rank: Same shared bias and 12×2 domain/skill generators, but each factor category has an unconstrained learned 2D vector. This is the equal-rank, equal-parameter direct low-rank control; no polar Mirror coordinate.
methods.no_code: One global 12-logit coefficient vector shared by all tasks, top-3 softmax.
methods.independent_upper: Not used as a quality control because held-out task target coefficients cannot be trained without leakage; report independent 12-float/task storage as an actual serialized storage-only reference.

training.loss: mean squared error to task output y
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest mean development MSE over the eight seen tasks; evaluate every 25 updates; patience 200 checks
training.native_support_adaptation: Adam lr=0.03 for exactly 300 full-batch updates over the 64 support examples; report query at 0, 25, 100, 300 updates
training.mirror_support_adaptation: None in primary screen; factorized code composition is evaluated zero-shot. This asymmetry is deliberate and reports the storage/generalization frontier; no query-based tuning.

metrics.storage: Actual safetensors bytes including shared anchors, generators, all registered factor codes, independent coefficient rows, and metadata. State tensors are packed into one flat vector per payload group; exact tensor shapes/order and schema metadata are serialized and charged. Report shared state plus registered factor state and the 16-row free SIMoE storage reference.
metrics.compute: Record examples, optimizer updates, coefficient generation operations and measured CPU batch-1 latency.

gates.aligned_composition: Mirror held-out query MSE <=1.05× ordinary low-rank control and <=1.10× adapted native SIMoE in at least 2/3 worlds.
gates.bytes: Mirror actual serialized coefficient-generator+factor-code payload <=80% of a serialized 16-row free SIMoE coefficient table. Also report whole inference payload including identical shared anchors; do not exclude anchors from total bytes, only from the incremental coefficient-state ratio.
gates.mirror_specificity: Compare Mirror with equal-rank ordinary low-rank control. Mirror-specific value requires a useful quality/byte/runtime Pareto gain; equivalence is not a Mirror-specific win.
gates.off_orbit: Report off-orbit degradation and the adapted SIMoE gap; do not require Mirror to represent arbitrary coefficient tables.
gates.decision: PROMISING only if aligned quality/bytes pass and Mirror improves on ordinary low-rank at matched budgets; FAIL if valid runs fail the aligned quality or storage gates; NOT ESTABLISHED for implementation or split invalidity.

amendments.reason: A development payload audit showed per-tensor safetensors key headers dominated this tiny coefficient model. Before full development/fresh audit runs, use one flat vector per anchor/generator/code payload and serialize the deterministic shape/order map in charged metadata. This is an inference serialization format change only; model parameterization, seeds, data, optimizer and gates are unchanged.

After the full development pass, a serialization replay showed duplicate sidecar JSON repeated the same static shape map already stored in each packed payload header. Keep all required layout/schema metadata charged once in the safetensors header and remove the duplicate sidecar. Report V2 bytes; no trained tensor, split, update count, metric or gate changes.

limitations: Synthetic fixed linear anchors, not a full SIMoE reproduction.
No LLM natural-language loss, sparse routing runtime, distributed upcycling, or full expert-network training claim.
Aligned worlds are designed to test compositional coefficient structure; off-orbit worlds test its boundary.
